newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Fayetteville, N.C..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Fayetteville, N.C..

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the Local Government Commission of North Carolina at its office in the Albemarle Building, 4th Floor, Room 411, 325 North Salisbury Street, Raleigh, North Carolina 27603-1385, until 11 o'clock A.M., North Carolina Time,

such bids to be opened in public at said time and place on said day, for the purchase of the following bonds of the City of Fayetteville, North Carolina, dated December 1, 1996, and maturing (subject to the right of prior

Copies of the Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form relating to the bonds may be obtained from the Local Government Commission (919-733-3064). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form in the Notice of Sale and Bid Form. The General Obligation Street Improvement Bonds, Series 1996 will be delivered on or about December 18, 1996, and the General Obligation Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1996 will be delivered on or about December 19, 1996.
